title: complete_task
prompt: Write complete_task(tasks, index) marking the task at index done, on a COPY, and returning it. Out-of-range index: return the copy unchanged.

tests.name: completes safely
tests.code:
tasks = [{"text": "a", "done": False}, {"text": "b", "done": False}]
r = complete_task(tasks, 1)
assert r[1]["done"] is True and r[0]["done"] is False, f"got {r}"
assert tasks[1]["done"] is False, "input unchanged"
assert complete_task(tasks, 99) == tasks, "out of range -> unchanged copy"
assert complete_task(tasks, -1) == tasks, "negative index is out of range here"
tests.hint: if not (0 <= index < len(tasks)): return list(tasks) — then copy-and-modify.
